Lobby.method: Largest-remainder wall quotas, then deterministic SHA256 ranking by scene/wall/frame identity; independent of layout RNG and no every-third pattern.

Game.method: Largest-remainder wall quotas, then deterministic SHA256 ranking by scene/wall/frame identity; independent of layout RNG and no every-third pattern.

interior_color.material_property: _InteriorColor (explicit linear RGB Vector; no automatic Color conversion)
interior_color.source: Exact uploaded swatch libfile_8941004c393081919e86231c0587e13b: 159x71, every pixel RGBA(32,32,32,255). See interior-colour-reference.json. Original textures remain unchanged.

coordinate_system: Unity world: x right, y up, z forward; quad UV bottom-left origin. Blender conversion (x,z,y).
provenance: Original RGBA sprite art; authored prefab geometry. Blender previews are source approximations, not native Unity output.

hallway_flashlight.source: GameMouseSpotlight scene component 24000033; local enabled fish screen beam
hallway_flashlight.closure_shader: _Closure 0..1. Mask/outline sample vertical UV = (uv.y-.5)/max(.001,1-closure)+.5; pupil original UV stays shifted by gaze. Original upper/lower outlines converge. Last8% crossfades to anti-aliased central stroke sampled from original outline RGB at(.5,.985). Pupil alpha fades to0. Closed stroke half-width.006UV.
hallway_flashlight.occlusion: Camera ScreenPointToRay to each eye, Physics.Raycast excluding final.03unit; ignore triggers.

eye.projection: local direction = inverse eye world rotation * (camera - eye position). offset = .35 * direction.xy / max(4, abs(direction.z)), then clamp to ellipse (.23,.12). Sample pupil at uv-offset, alpha multiplied by mask alpha; outline source-over pupil. Opaque neutral-grey picture-frame opening. Height-first original eye sizing via per-frame eye_frame_uv_rect; complete eye including outline and closed lid multiplied by exact opening_mask. One composite quad, no stencil dependency.
